title: Kernel Memory Inspector
shortDesc: Windows x64 driver to inspect physical and virtual memory structures directly.
fullDesc: A kernel driver developed in C and x64 ASM to explore internal Windows structures (EPROCESS, ActiveProcessLinks, page tables). It maps process memory via MDL mappings without creating intrusive userland handles.
features: Physical and virtual memory read/write via MDL
Manual virtual address translation (CR3 -> PTE/PDE)
Detection of unlisted modules
High-performance CLI interface with hexadecimal memory dump
instructions:
# Build with WDK
msbuild /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64

# Service startup (TestSigning mode)
sc create MemInspect type= kernel binPath= C:\MemInspect.sys
sc start MemInspect

title: Indirect System Call Engine
shortDesc: Modern C++20 library to execute clean NT system calls without triggering userland hook alerts.
fullDesc: Implements modern system service number extraction techniques to dynamically resolve SSNs from ntdll even when prologue bytes are modified. System calls jump to legitimate syscall stubs to maintain a clean call stack.
features: API resolution using ROR13 hashing (zero plaintext strings)
Automatic hook inspection and neighbor SSN inference
Call stack preservation targeting ntdll
Compatible with modern Windows 10 and 11 builds

title: DirectX SwapChain Overlay Hook
shortDesc: Universal DX11 / DX12 swapchain hook with ImGui integration.
fullDesc: High-performance graphics overlay framework that hooks IDXGISwapChain::Present without interfering with engine frame pacing or causing visual tearing.
features: Compatible with DX11 and DX12 games
ImGui rendering pipeline with zero frame stutter
Automated mouse input and cursor state management
Clean detachment and hot-unhook support
instructions:
# Compile dynamic module
cmake -B build
cmake --build build --config Release

title: PE Static Analysis & Unpacker
shortDesc: Modular Python tool to inspect PE headers, sections, and entropy anomalies.
fullDesc: Automated binary triage toolkit calculating sliding window entropy across PE sections to pinpoint packed code, dynamic imports, and abnormal section permissions.
features: Section entropy graphs using matplotlib
Dynamic import address table reconstruction
Detection of common packing wrappers
JSON export of triage metadata
instructions:
pip install -r requirements.txt
python analyze.py --target binary.exe --output report.json

title: Operator Vault Portfolio
shortDesc: Modern, zero-dependency dark portfolio to showcase code projects.
fullDesc: Lightweight, responsive static web portfolio template written in vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, loading its data from a JSON catalog with search, filter, and modal inspection.
features: Instant real-time search and multi-category filtering
Responsive layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Clean modal inspection with code block copying
Local storage sync for testing and offline usage
